Banjo-Kazooie.name: Banjo-Kazooie
Banjo-Kazooie.summary: Trouble brews when Gruntilda the witch captures the unbearably beautiful cub, Tooty. But before the grisly hag can steal the bear's good looks, big brother Banjo and his fine-feathered friend, Kazooie, join forces to stop her. Combining their 24 moves and special powers, Banjo and Kazooie will fend off armies of beasts. Bear and bird must hunt down the 100 puzzle pieces and 900 musical notes that will ultimately lead them to Gruntilda. However. miles of swamp, desert, and snow and one bear of an adventure stand in their way.

Telefoot Soccer 2000.name: Telefoot Soccer 2000
Telefoot Soccer 2000.summary: Telefoot Soccer 2000 is the French port of Michael Owen's WLS 2000, made in collaboration with Téléfoot.

Viewpoint 2064.name: Viewpoint 2064
Viewpoint 2064.summary: A prototype of the unreleased Viewpoint 2064 for the Nintendo 64.
